text: One of the worst feelings to feel, I think, in this human existence is to be in a relationship where two people mutually love one another, but know that your needs are not being met. And even though they love you so wholly and so deeply with all of themselves, they are not capable of giving you what you need. I am honestly quite tired of how casually people throw around the word love nowadays. We love each other so deeply, but my needs are not being met. Translation, I want another man who will actually fit my criteria. And that is fine, but stop lying to yourself and call it love. If you are with a man and you feel like he cannot give you what you need, the solution is simple, you leave. You don't sit there being a drama queen, filming TikToks about how tragic it all is. That is not love. That's indecision mixed with attachment. And this goes both ways. You probably heard men say similar things. I love her so much, but I still want to sleep with other women. No, you don't love her. You have strong feelings, maybe. An emotional attachment, but not love. Love is not staying while secretly wishing you were with someone else. Because as cliche as it sounds, when you truly love, when you truly choose a partner for yourself, this is the best person for you. And you would get what you need from that person. And you know what is the most shocking part here? It is that this video has over 4.3 views, more than, imagine, 600,000 likes and thousands of comments. And most of them from women saying things like, This is my life. Or I feel so seen. What the hell is going on? Stop being drama queens of a relationship that doesn't work. Stop calling it the worst feeling to feel. Stop using word love where it doesn't fit. Solution is simple. You do not get what you need. You leave the relationship and try to find it.
